title: When no work order qualifies, every tab shows "Empty bays, endless possibilities. Get Going!" and no Totals row
permissions_required: A role with the permission that grants access to Work In Progress reports (the report reuses one existing reporting permission — Story 1 prerequisite).
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Work In Progress report is open.
steps: 1. Set the date range and location so that no open work order qualifies (for example, a Custom range over dates with no work orders created).
2. Open each of the four tabs and read the data area.
expected: 1. Each tab shows the standard reports no-data message "Empty bays, endless possibilities. Get Going!" in place of rows.
2. No tab shows a Totals row.
design_ref: none — design not yet available (spec-only authoring)
spec_ref: specs/wip-work-in-progress.md Story 2 S2-N1; §7 User Feedback Summary
notes: No-data message text is verbatim from §7.
